observations: Photo 0 shows a complete industrial straight-stitch sewing machine set up on its table stand with motor, knee lever, and foot pedal (red).
Brand name 'EMEL' is legible in red lettering on the machine head in photo 0.
A small switch box with red/green buttons is mounted on the table top, right side.
Table and stand appear to be the standard metal/laminate industrial type that usually comes bundled with such machines.
Background shows other boxed stock including a box labelled 'YAMATA' motor, suggesting a dealer/shop setting with multiple machines, not necessarily this unit's own packaging.

No photo of the machine running, stitching a sample, or the underside/motor wiring.

risks.risk: 'Seconds' quality grade could mean cosmetic or functional defects (second-grade/factory reject).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle plate, feed dog, and any visible scratches/defects, plus seller's explanation of what 'seconds' means here.

risks.risk: Missing or mismatched motor rating/voltage (could be 110V vs 220V, or underpowered clone motor).
risks.proof: Photo of the motor's rating plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/unverified motor spec, treated as base value only

risks.risk: Accessories (bobbins, extra needles, oil, manual) may not be included despite being standard for such listings.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare machine without accessories

risks.risk: Table/stand could be used, repainted, or non-matching aftermarket stand rather than original Emel stand.
risks.proof: Photo showing any stand branding or manufacturer sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic stand, no brand premium

proof_requests: Video of the machine running and stitching a sample.
Close-up of the motor rating plate and machine serial/model plate.
Close-up of needle plate, feed dog, and any visible wear or defects.
Photo of all accessories included in the sale.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Emel-branded industrial straight sewing machine with table and motor, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified working condition, unverified 'seconds' grade) while proof requests would support a higher valuation.
